info.description:
Vigolium — High-fidelity vulnerability scanner fusing agentic AI with native speed, modularity, and precision

## Response versions

Responses default to v1 (server.api_version_default). Ask for v2 with `Accept: application/vnd.vigolium.v2+json`, `Vigolium-Api-Version: 2` or `?api_version=2`; every response reports the version it used in the `Vigolium-Api-Version` header. v1 bodies are the historical shapes (ErrorResponse, PaginatedResponse) plus `error_code`, `schema_version` and `command`. v2 lists use ListEnvelopeV2 and v2 errors use ErrorEnvelopeV2. An unknown X-Project-UUID answers 404 `project_not_found` unless the request sends `X-Project-Create: 1` (or `?create=1`).
info.title: Vigolium API

post.description: Provides an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. Accepts standard chat messages and returns a completion response.
Dispatches the audit and/or piolium harness. driver=auto runs audit when available and falls back to piolium; driver=both runs both sequentially.

post.description: Starts a durable olium autopilot scan. The nested audit harness (vigolium-audit or piolium, run before the autonomous operator on a source-aware run) is off unless the request asks for it with audit_mode, audit or piolium (or the prompt does), as with `vigolium agent autopilot --audit`. Heavy-run quotas return 429 when saturated.

Executes a single-shot AI agent query with template-based or inline prompts. Supports source code context via the source field. When stream is true, returns a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream of agent output. Good for code review, endpoint discovery, and secret detection.

Starts an olium-driven swarm scan. The pipeline normalizes input, optionally authenticates and analyzes source, discovers and probes the target, plans modules/extensions, runs native scans, replans empty results when useful, and optionally triages. Heavy-run quotas return 429 when saturated.

post.description: Re-runs the module behind one finding against the request it originally scanned and records whether it reproduces: `vigolium finding verify` over REST. The finding is named by numeric id or finding hash (12+ char prefix) and must belong to the request's project (X-Project-UUID). Verdicts: confirmed, not_reproduced, inconclusive (target unreachable, module timed out or failed, baseline not reconstructable), unsupported (agent, audit, OAST and known-issue-scan findings; an ext-* module that is not loaded). The verdict is written to the finding's verification field unless no_write or dry_run is set; mark also moves not_reproduced to false_positive and confirmed to confirmed. A passive finding is re-analyzed on its stored record without sending a request unless refetch is set. Answered synchronously (timeout, default 2m, at most 10m). v1 returns the result object; v2 a one-item list envelope (kind mutation) with changed, action, dry_run, written and the verdict tally. Requires operator role.

Starts an asynchronous scan of one raw HTTP request (base64) and answers 202 with the scan UUID. Without target_url the scheme is settled the way `vigolium scan-request` settles it: an absolute-form request line, a Host on :80/:443, or a same-origin Origin/Referer decide; otherwise the target is probed (TCP connect, plus a TLS handshake on an explicit non-standard port) instead of assuming https. no_scheme_probe keeps the https default. The response names the target and its scheme_source (explicit, port, origin, referer, probe, default). Scope is checked before the probe, so a refused target is never contacted.
